reason: I'll download it because I always try the new local apps first, but downloading isn't booking -- I'm not letting someone into my home or handing a kid over to a tutor just because an ad looked slick. I'd want to know people near me are actually using it.
objection: Will there actually be enough verified freelancers near me when I open it, or will half the categories in Chennai/Coimbatore be empty with one or two profiles -- I've opened enough new local apps to know that's usually the case at launch.
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour or someone in my building WhatsApp group had already booked someone real through it and said it went fine, I'd try booking too.
